pt.h: O El Capitan serviu de marco para viajantes na rota da diligência Butterfield; as ruínas de uma estação estão perto de Pine Springs. Os apaches mescaleros viviam nas montanhas. Wallace Pratt, geólogo do petróleo, doou o McKittrick Canyon. O parque abriu em 30/09/1972.
pt.ff: As montanhas são parte do recife fóssil Capitan, do mar Permiano, um dos mais bem conservados do mundo. O Guadalupe Peak (2.667 m) é o ponto mais alto do Texas. Florestas de pinheiro e bordos nos cânions contrastam com o deserto de Chihuahua.

en.r: Montanhas de Guadalupe National Park is a national park in Texas, United States. It covers 366 km² and has been protected since 1972. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: El Capitan was a landmark for travellers on the Butterfield stagecoach route; a station's ruins stand near Pine Springs. The Mescalero Apache lived in the mountains. Petroleum geologist Wallace Pratt donated McKittrick Canyon. The park opened on 30 September 1972.
en.ff: The mountains are part of the Capitan fossil reef from the Permian sea, one of the best preserved in the world. Guadalupe Peak (2,667 m) is the highest point in Texas. Pine and maple forests in the canyons contrast with the Chihuahuan Desert.

es.h: El Capitán sirvió de referencia a los viajeros de la ruta de diligencias Butterfield; las ruinas de una estación están cerca de Pine Springs. Los apaches mescaleros vivían en las montañas. El geólogo petrolero Wallace Pratt donó el McKittrick Canyon. El parque abrió el 30/09/1972.
es.ff: Las montañas son parte del arrecife fósil Capitán, del mar Pérmico, uno de los mejor conservados del mundo. El Guadalupe Peak (2.667 m) es el punto más alto de Texas. Bosques de pinos y arces en los cañones contrastan con el desierto de Chihuahua.

en.h: Archaeological sites nearly 10,000 years old, then the Comanche, Apache, ranchers and miners. Texas bought the land and donated it, and the park was created on 12 June 1944. It is a UNESCO biosphere reserve.
